title: English Practice Quiz 0876
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A task scheduled 'biweekly' may mean:
options: twice a week or every two weeks, depending on context
questions.explanation: Biweekly is ambiguous and can mean either twice weekly or every two weeks.

questions.question: If a shift starts at 7:30 a.m. and lasts 8 hours, it ends at:
questions.explanation: Adding eight hours to 7:30 a.m. gives 3:30 p.m.

questions.question: A 'buffer period' in a schedule is:
options: extra time allowed for unexpected delays
questions.explanation: A buffer provides spare time to absorb delays.

questions.question: A task marked 'overdue' is:
questions.explanation: Overdue means the due time has passed.

questions.question: To 'reschedule' an appointment is to:
options: arrange it for a different time
questions.explanation: Reschedule means set a new date or time.

questions.question: Which task should generally receive priority?
options: A low-impact task due next month
An urgent safety issue requiring immediate action
questions.explanation: Immediate safety concerns require prompt attention.

questions.question: If a deadline is extended, it has been:
'At your earliest convenience' means:
options: when you can reasonably do it soon
questions.explanation: The phrase politely asks for action when reasonably possible.

questions.question: A contingency plan is prepared for:
questions.explanation: A contingency plan outlines responses to potential problems.
